Venue Report: Wankhede Stadium, Mumbai. Capacity: 33108. Pitch type: Flat, true bounce. Average first innings score: 175. Conditions: Batting-friendly. Dew factor: High evening. Best strategy: Bat first, use pace death bowling. Notes: Short square boundary around 55m. True bounce helps batters, but fast bowlers can hit the bat hard. Evening dew favours chasing.

Venue Report: MA Chidambaram Stadium, Chennai. Capacity: 50000. Pitch type: Slow, turning. Average first innings score: 155. Conditions: Bowling-friendly. Dew factor: Low. Best strategy: Bowl first, use spinners in overs 7-15. Notes: Most spin-friendly IPL venue. Slow dry surface breaks up progressively. Spinners become very effective in the second innings.

Venue Report: M Chinnaswamy Stadium, Bengaluru. Capacity: 35000. Pitch type: Flat, short boundary. Average first innings score: 185. Conditions: Very batting-friendly. Dew factor: Moderate. Best strategy: Bat first, score 180+. No safe total.. Notes: Short boundaries and high altitude make the ball travel further. 200 plus totals are common and no total is safe.

Venue Report: Eden Gardens, Kolkata. Capacity: 66000. Pitch type: Good pace and bounce. Average first innings score: 165. Conditions: Balanced. Dew factor: High evening. Best strategy: Flexible. Spinners and pacers both effective.. Notes: Balanced venue where pace and spin can both work depending on match conditions.

Venue Report: Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad. Capacity: 132000. Pitch type: Flat, big ground. Average first innings score: 170. Conditions: Slightly batting-friendly. Dew factor: Low. Best strategy: Bat first. Spinners effective in second half.. Notes: Large boundaries make placement important. Spinners can matter later in the match.

Venue Report: Rajiv Gandhi Intl. Stadium, Hyderabad. Capacity: 55000. Pitch type: Flat, bouncy. Average first innings score: 178. Conditions: Batting-friendly. Dew factor: High. Best strategy: Bat first. Dew makes chasing very easy in second innings.. Notes: SRH home ground became a feared batting venue in 2024. Flat pitch and heavy evening dew strongly help chasing.

Venue Report: Sawai Mansingh Stadium, Jaipur. Capacity: 23000. Pitch type: Slow, low. Average first innings score: 158. Conditions: Bowling-friendly. Dew factor: Low. Best strategy: Bowl first. Spinners dominate afternoon games.. Notes: Slow low surface where spinners are especially useful in afternoon games.

Venue Report: IS Bindra Stadium, Mohali. Capacity: 26950. Pitch type: Good carry, seam. Average first innings score: 168. Conditions: Balanced. Dew factor: Moderate. Best strategy: Flexible. Fast bowlers get swing early.. Notes: Good carry and early seam movement can help fast bowlers.
